purpose: One ~200 MB fetch + a seconds-long cut per install, instead of 346 pre-cut artifacts that rot between releases. The recipes are PARAMETRIC in CUT — comuna-package.sh substitutes; there is one recipe per master, not one per comuna.

comuna_reference.origin: the DEIS comuna reference sheet ('Codigo Comuna DEIS.ods') — the coding authority: 346 comunas incl. 12202 Antártica, zero numeric conflicts with any in-repo source
comuna_reference.conversion: codes zfill(5) — the sheet stores FLOATS and regions 01–09 lost their leading zero (206 of 347 rows); glosas NBSP -> regular space (Isla de Pascua, Pedro Aguirre Cerda); the 99999/Ignorada sentinel kept and marked — DEIS's 'unknown comuna', not a comuna; no register row references it

masters.notes: the national UV cadastre (.shp inside; the warehouse's derived GeoJSON conversion is sources.json:351's pattern — ogr2ogr, once per host); t_com codes are 5-digit strings but one carries a LEADING SPACE (' 04301' Ovalle) — trim before comparing

the national facility registry, raw schema — NOT the register gestion ships: the register is the primary-care trim of the DEIS pipeline's normalized export (a different artifact of the same registry); the codes agree (verified: every register comuna_codigo exists in the comuna reference). Pinned to the resource's own download URL in its stable no-filename form — it serves the current edition regardless of the dated asset name behind it (the catalog row moves monthly; a moved master fails the fetch-verify loudly and is re-recorded by edit). FORMAT TRAPS, measured at implement: the dump is SEMICOLON-delimited (csv.DictReader needs delimiter=';'), and TipoEstablecimientoGlosa carries FULL phrases ('Centro de Salud Familiar (CESFAM)'), so the subcategory map matches on substrings, never on bare siglas
comuna BOUNDARIES only — 345 comunas, NO Antártica; geometry source, never the coding authority (that is comunas-deis.csv)

recipes.selector: trim(t_com) zfill(5) == CUT — the trim is REQUIRED, not hygiene: the app-side tool compares t_com RAW (apps/territorio tools/comuna-cut.php:67) and the master carries one leading-space code (' 04301' Ovalle, sources.json:354)
recipes.transform: uid = the official t_id_uv_ca; category/subcategory = division_territorial/unidad_vecinal; collection-level comuna claim '<CUT>' — the claim is what arms refuseAnotherComuna per-file (apps/territorio ImportService::refuseAnotherComuna)
recipes.conversion: zip holds a .shp — ogr2ogr converts once per host (the tool comuna-cut.php names for exactly this); the warehouse's own conversion used pyshp 3.1.6 (sources.json:354 records it + the leading-space caveat)

recipes.transform: uid='deis:<EstablecimientoCodigo>'; subcategory by glosa phrase — 'CESFAM' in TipoEstablecimientoGlosa -> cesfam, 'SAPU' -> sapu, else establecimiento (measured: the dump writes full phrases, and the pilot's own cut counts 9/8/27); address=TipoViaGlosa+NombreVia+Numero; collection-level comuna claim '<CUT>'; keep the 3 coordinate-less rows of a cut OUT (a Point needs coordinates)

basemap.contract: the verify contract only — bbox, the REF derivation (the establishment's own DEIS point, scripts/refresh-basemap.sh), min size 500 MB; the source URL is un-pinnable by design (dated builds, old ones 404)
